gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: Sawir weyn, GIF ama fiidiyow leh cinwaan iyo qoraal korkiisa ah, oo meel kasta oo bogga lagu dhigo.

configure.title: Sawir ama fiidiyow
configure.description: Fayl JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 ama WebM ah.

configure.title: Qoraal beddel ah
configure.description: Sharax sawirka. Ka tag madhan marka uu qurxin oo keliya yahay.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Cinwaanka ka muuqda warbaahinta korkeeda. Ka tag madhan haddii aadan rabin.

configure.title: Qoraal
configure.description: Qoraalka ka muuqda cinwaanka hoostiisa, warbaahinta korkeeda.

configure.title: Ballac buuxa
configure.description: Ka socod geeska ilaa geeska halkii uu ku fadhiyi lahaa tiirka nuxurka.

configure.title: Qaabaynta
configure.description: Sida sawirku u fadhiyo cabbir kasta oo shaashad ah

advanced.title: Dabcin
advanced.description: Midab la dul dhigo warbaahinta. Marka cinwaan ama qoraal jiro had iyo jeer mid ayaa jira, si qoraalku u ahaado mid la akhriyi karo.

advanced.title: Barta diiradda dhinac
advanced.description: Qaybta sawirka ee muuqata marka la jaro, laga bilaabo 0 (bidix) ilaa 100 (midig).

advanced.title: Barta diiradda hoos
advanced.description: Qaybta sawirka ee muuqata marka la jaro, laga bilaabo 0 (kor) ilaa 100 (hoos).
